feeds.title: Group Homes Australia » Dementia
feeds.description: Founded in 2012, Group Homes Australia offers a social model of care for people living with dementia. At Group Homes Australia, we specialize in supporting those with dementia and high care needs to live purposeful and meaningful lives.

feeds.title: Alzheimer's Queensland Blog
feeds.description: Read news and blog posts related to Dementia and get to know the stories of people experiencing Alzheimer's disease. Alzheimer's Queensland (AQ) is Australia's largest dementia association. Our mission at AQ is to work collectively with our clients, to maintain their dignity, remain socially and physically active, and deter their premature placement in residential facilities.

feeds.title: Dementia Champion Blog
feeds.description: Tim England is a Dementia Champion and a freelance dementia consultant. Here he provides public, community, and business dementia education that builds awareness of dementia.

feeds.title: Dementia Caring News
feeds.description: Dementia Caring is an approved provider of NDIS and home care package Services. We understand that caring for a loved one isn't always easy, but our team of dementia care and carer support services are experts in working with the often specific needs that those suffering from dementia have.

feeds.title: DR Care Solutions Blog
feeds.description: Find news and blogs from Danielle Robertson, the Founder & CEO of DR Care Solutions and a specialist consultant for aged care, disability care, retirement & health care. DR Care Solutions offers the best quality care options.

feeds.title: Relish Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about dementia and ongoing research into the syndrome on The Relish Dementia blog. At The Relish Dementia, our mission is to help improve the overall well-being of people with dementia by providing fun, meaningful activities that help build their relationships with their family, friends, and caregivers.
